framework.name: net/http
framework.validation_and_error_policy: Strict create payload; safe RFC 9457 errors; reference/README.md
framework.test_host_and_lifecycle: Packaged process, loopback HTTP, bounded shutdown, real PostgreSQL

architecture.style: Single reference service with transport-independent domain validation
architecture.domain_logic_pattern: Transaction Script; no speculative CQRS or generic repository
module_boundaries: Domain validates customer values without HTTP or database imports
Persistence uses parameters and an atomic customer/audit transaction

interfaces.compatibility_policy: No unreviewed removal/type/requiredness change to accepted reference contract

data.migration_tool: backend_standard.migrations; ordered SQL, checksums, advisory lock
data.transaction_policy: Unique canonical email per tenant; customer and audit commit atomically; failed transaction leaves neither

security.authentication: Synthetic HS256 JWT fixture; issuer backend-reference; audience customers; expiration required; not a production identity-provider choice
security.authorization: customers:read/write scopes and backend-checked tenant ownership
security.blocking_policy: Reject scanner failure, missing inventory, any reported vulnerability, or known secret pattern; no implicit exceptions

quality_targets.request_limits: 8192-byte create body; names 1..100 Unicode scalars; email <=254 ASCII bytes; list limit 1..100
quality_targets.timeouts_and_retry_policy: Database operation deadline 3 seconds; no automatic retry; functional timeout acceptance <6.5 seconds
quality_targets.observability: Structured request events/correlation; no credentials or customer body in logs
quality_targets.performance_budget: Reference functional deadlines/startup only; production throughput/load SLO is outside this reference scope

execution_policy.coding_task_context: One bounded task per fresh implementation session
execution_policy.dispatch_claim_policy: External Coordinator exclusive claim required; not supplied by this reference runner
execution_policy.integration_target: Reviewed PR integration candidate against main
human_decision_boundaries: Product intent and accepted contract changes
execution_policy.model_routing: No LLM is used by reference verification; agent runtime is a separate integration
